Kubernetes’ key-value store for storing data about cluster configuration, the current and desired state of all the components running in the cluster.

chart.description: The latency distributions of fsync called by WAL(write ahead logging)
chart.name: WAL latency (s)
chart.programText:
A = data('etcd_disk_wal_fsync_duration_seconds_sum', filter=filter('service.name', '*etcd')).sum(by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'k8s.node.name']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('etcd_disk_wal_fsync_duration_seconds_count', filter=filter('service.name', '*etcd')).sum(by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'k8s.node.name']).publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A/B).publish(label='Average Latency')

chart.name: Rest client duration (s)

A = data('rest_client_request_duration_seconds_count', filter=filter('service.name', '*apiserver')).sum(by=['k8s.node.name', 'k8s.cluster.name']).publish(label='number of request', enable=False)
